platforms.architecture: AEE2001: first-generation VAN+CAN architecture; main nodes on CAN, comfort/body on VAN; K-line also part of the architecture.
platforms.non_generalization_boundary: Unsupported VAN/K-line transports must not be coerced into classic CAN routes.

platforms.architecture: AEE2004: first full-CAN generation; 500 kbit/s HS inter-systems CAN, 125 kbit/s low-speed comfort/body CAN, LIN; source lists UDS/EOBD.
platforms.non_generalization_boundary: AEE2004 architecture does not imply every ECU is visible through the same DLC path.

platforms.architecture: AEE2010: second full-CAN generation with HS inter-systems/LAS, multiple low-speed domains and LIN; full/eco/EV variants documented at architecture level.
platforms.non_generalization_boundary: Mechanical platform name alone is insufficient; ECU identity and route evidence still gate DIDs.

platforms.architecture: Citroën C4 III / project C41; project-observed modern PSA CAN diagnostic branch.
platforms.gateway_architecture: project observation; exact full architecture not promoted beyond C41
classification_evidence: project vehicle capture in current uds-map
platforms.non_generalization_boundary: One project-observed C41 vehicle; use to seed family comparison, not as all-Citroën truth.

platforms.architecture: Peugeot e-208 modern Stellantis/PSA EV branch with exact source-backed CAN11 enhanced routes.
platforms.non_generalization_boundary: e-208 evidence may be a useful eCMP-family lead, but this pack does not promote it to every eCMP vehicle.

platforms.architecture: Mitsubishi-derived i-MiEV sibling EV branch used by Peugeot iOn and Citroën C-Zero.
platforms.gateway_architecture: separate from mainstream PSA eCMP/AEE route assumptions
platforms.non_generalization_boundary: Do not reuse iOn/C-Zero service-21 routes on mainstream PSA EVs.

platforms.architecture: Placeholder for newer PSA/Stellantis electrical generations not safely normalized by this research pass.
platforms.non_generalization_boundary: No traffic may be generated from this placeholder.
